experiments.study_type: Conditional knockout phenotyping of glutamatergic Ago2 in brain development (Slc17a6-Cre, Ago2 flox/flox mice)
experiments.procedure_text: Glutamatergic Ago2 conditional knockout mice assessed for postnatal growth, survival, cortical development, synaptogenesis, vascularization, NVU formation, and neuroinflammation.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Deletion of glutamatergic Argonaute2 impairs postnatal growth and development in mice
experiments.animal_counts_evidence: n = 19 mice) and a littermate control (of n = 5 mice)
experiments.test_system_evidence: Brains were isolated from mice and postfixed overnight in 4% PFA
